Proof in the paper.LaCoO3 and LaCo0.95Pd0.05O3: The typical rhombohedral structure for LaCoO3 was maintained after Pd incorporation. The Rietveld refinement method allows the calculation of structural parameters collected in Table 1 showing an elongation of the distance a and a parallel expansion of the elementary cell volume.
Proof in the paper.LaFeO3: The orthorhombic phase of LaFeO3 was identified from measurements of the lattices fringes of the (0 0 2), (1 1 1), (2 0 0), and (2 0 0 2) crystal planes characteristic of this structure.
Proof in the paper.Pt/LaFeO3: Platinum particles were also observed, with measured lattice fringes corresponding to the (1 1 1) planes of metallic platinum. Among the observed particles, HRTEM micrographs recorded on Pt/LaFe(R300) show a preferential orientation of the (1 1 1) crystal planes of the Pt particles, anchored to the different (2 0 0), (1 1 1), (0 0 2), and (2 0 0 2) planes characteristic of LaFeO3 structure.
